A. Boundaries / note structure

S01p. 50 — The quotation after "W nielicznych wypadkach"

Draft: Body ends mid-sentence ("…W nielicznych wypadkach", the sentence resumes on p. 51 "wybór wymagał zatwierdzenia…"). Then the old-Polish quotation "z pierwszego małżeństwa dzieci równo należeć maią…", then note "1 Kar. II, fol. 239.".

Why doubtful: I read the quotation as NOTE 1 of p. 50 (a wilkierz quote). Its marker + first words sit on a line that defeats OCR even at 6x - in the draft it is left as body text. If it is a note, the body also needs its marker anchor (which word carries marker 1?).

My reading: Note 1 of p. 50; please confirm - and if so, the marker anchor needs the print.

S02p. 14 — Is the long commentary ONE note or several?

Draft: Note 1 = "Podaną cyfrę trudno skontrolować…" runs ~9 printed lines of settlement commentary (Dąbrowo, Grabowiec, Łoskońskie… Goraj) set solid, no readable marker digits.

Why doubtful: The block could be one long note or several (2., 3. …) with unread markers.

My reading: One note; if the print splits it, the split points are in the crop.

B. Numbers — each could change a figure

S03p. 24 — 13.915 dymów

Draft: "Rzeczywista liczba dymów wiejskich … wynosi 13.915 dymów … W Tod. 89 brak zatem 552 dymów"

Why doubtful: Arithmetic: 13.353 + 552 = 13.905, not 13.915; and 552 × 6,41 = 3.538 fits the given person-count, so the TOTAL is the misread digit.

My reading: 13.905

S04p. 26 — 514 dymów × 6,05

Draft: "Ostatnia rubryka aneksu I b wykazuje 514 dymów … współczynnik 6.05, otrzymamy 3.122 osoby"

Why doubtful: 514 × 6,05 = 3.110, not 3.122.

My reading: Either "516 dymów" or "3.110 osób"

S05p. 68 — 608 morgów

Draft: "Tutaj także role liczono na ślady, te jednakże równały się 2 włókom czyli 60 morgom. Tak samo w pobliskiej majętności wieleńskiej na włókę liczono 50 lub nawet 608 morgów normalnej wielkości."

Why doubtful: 608 morgów per włóka is impossible (a włóka = 60 morgów); the trailing 8 looks like the footnote marker fused to "60".

My reading: "60 morgów" (the 8 = the footnote marker)

S06p. 66 (Tabela V) — kościański row

Draft: "kościański ......... = 45,5 | 6,8 | 41,7"

Why doubtful: The percent row must sum to 100 (45,5+6,8+41,7=94,0), and 41.7% of 44 settlements is not 21.

My reading: third value "47,7" (21/44 = 47.7%)

S07p. 43, note 2 — r. 1043

Draft: "W r. 1043 olędrom Marianowa przedłużono dzierżawę na lat 30"

Why doubtful: Impossible year; the note's context is the 1677+ privilege era.

My reading: "r. 1643"

S08p. 30, note 4 — r. 1053

Draft: "Inwentarz z r. 1053 odróżnia wsie polskie, niemieckie…"

Why doubtful: Impossible year; the parallel note (30-3) cites the same inventory as r. 1653.

My reading: "r. 1653"

S09p. 16 — Wymysłowo 1889/1890

Draft: "Tp. 89, 90 — Wymysłowo, 1889 — 1 dym, 1890 — 1 dym"

Why doubtful: Impossible years; the whole passage is about Tp. 89/90 = 1789/1790.

My reading: "1789 — 1 dym, 1790 — 1 dym"

S10ap. 98 — 21 razy większa

Draft: "Jest jednak od niego 21 razy większa. Czynsz wynosił 2627 zł."

Why doubtful: The context figure is 6588 zł: 6588/2627 ≈ 2.5, not 21.

My reading: "2½ razy większa"

S10bp. 98 — 8814 zł z włóki

Draft: "na włókę przypadnie: w Nowych Dworach 8814 zł"

Why doubtful: Larger than the 3187 zł total for the whole osada.

My reading: "88 zł 14 gr" (fits the "44 ½ zł" half-włóka figure below it)

S11p. 86 — od 301 do 70? tynfów

Draft: "przeciętnie 50 tynfów, wahając się w poszczególnych wypadkach od 301 do 70? tynfów"

Why doubtful: The range must bracket the 50 average.

My reading: "od 30 do 70 tynfów"

S12p. 77 — beczki i garnce

Draft: "wyszynk roczny wynosił 229 beczek 56 garncy piwa, oraz 12 beczek -12121/ garnca wódki"

Why doubtful: Digit mush. Sanity: 8300 garnców piwa / 1152 osób ≈ 8 garnców per head suggests the beer figure; wódka 12 beczek i 12½ garnca fits the 1:16 ratio.

My reading: verify both numbers from the crop

S13p. 78 — 4:58 litra

Draft: "garnca berlińskiego, który zawierał 4:58 litra"

Why doubtful: The colon is not this book's decimal separator.

My reading: "3,58" or "4,58 litra"

S14p. 68 — The inline table: włóka area per pręt length

Draft: Draft: "wyniesie 16,80 ha ,, „ U ) „„ ) 19, 10 H 1) ”» ” ,) 81/, x ) ,) ,, , 7 » » „ 24 20"

Why doubtful: The print tabulates włóka area (ha) for pręt lengths 7½, 8, 8½, 9 łokci. Math: 7½→16,80; 8→19,10; 8½→21,58; 9→24,20.

My reading: confirm the four pairs

S15p. 98 — przyorali 52/5 / 4%/, włóki

Draft: "przyorali sobie 52/5, a w Folsztynie 4%/, włóki"

Why doubtful: Fraction glyphs; the Folsztyn figure fits ~4¾ (2627 zł over ~32 włóki).

My reading: read both fractions from the crop

S16p. 47 — 59/., sumy sprzedażnej

Draft: "12-ty grosz 3, wyjątkowo 59/., sumy sprzedażnej"

Why doubtful: "5%" or "5/9 of the sale sum" - different meanings.

My reading: carried from the earlier sitting; the glyph decides

S17p. 100 — 109%/; kwoty

Draft: "i opłat nie przekroczy 109%/; kwoty czynszowej"

Why doubtful: 109% of the rent is odd; possibly 1/9 or 10%.

My reading: read the glyph

S18p. 43 — "44 lata 3,"

Draft: "W Ol. Ujskich dzierżawa wynosiła 44 lata 3, w Ol. Nowe Dwory 60 lat"

Why doubtful: The stray "3," right after "lata" - is it marker 3 riding the number, or part of the figure?

My reading: confirm "44 lata" and the "3"

E. The German petition, p. 97

S19p. 97 — The German petition

Draft: The 1743 petition of the Ujskie Olędry is quoted in German at length; the OCR is heavily corrupted ("Allcrgnidigst", "gintzlich", "Kónigł").

Why doubtful: If the quote matters for the edition it needs a careful re-read; otherwise mark it as an unchecked quotation (sic).

My reading: editor's call: re-read or sic
